likelyQuestions: Analyse the time complexity of the given recursive increment function.
Solve the recurrence relation T(n) = 2T(n/4) + sqrt(n) using the recursion tree method.
Explain greedy algorithms and discuss their limitations.
Find the minimum spanning tree of a given graph using Kruskal's algorithm.
Explain Strassen's Matrix multiplication algorithm and analyse its complexity.
Describe an efficient approach to find a local minimum in a complete binary tree using O(log n) probes.
Give the best case and worst case conditions for quick sort, write its recurrences, and analyse all case complexities.
Explain the greedy algorithm for solving the Fractional Knapsack problem and analyse its complexity.
Design a greedy algorithm to place sequenced songs on CDs to minimize the number of CDs needed.
Explain the greedy algorithm for generating Huffman codes and analyse its complexity.
